parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description: The maximum bandwidth that can be allocated within the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. Unit: Mbps.

parameters.name: BandwidthPackageId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

parameters.name: EipId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the EIP that has been added to the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.
